edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as owner during construction, giving the deployer privileged control.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner to gate transferOwnership.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner to gate transferAnyERC20Token.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before changing ownership.
transferOwnership writes the caller-supplied _newOwner into the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership resets the newOwner state variable to address(0).
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] using the caller-controlled address.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller-controlled address.
transferFrom reads and debits allowed[from][msg.sender] with the caller-controlled address.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller-controlled address.
transfer passes balances[msg.sender] and tokens to safeSub.
transfer passes balances[to] and tokens to safeAdd.
transfer updates the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transferFrom uses safeSub for balances[from] and the allowance.
transferFrom uses safeAdd for the recipient balance.
transferFrom updates balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
approve writes the allowance into the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowance into the allowed mapping before the external call.
safeAdd performs the raw addition before the overflow require check.
The unchecked sum is returned by safeAdd when the require guard passes.
safeAdd reads its first operand parameter.
safeAdd reads its second operand parameter.
safeAdd assigns the sum to its local result c.
safeSub reads its minuend parameter.
safeSub reads its subtrahend parameter.
safeSub assigns the difference to its local result c.
safeMul reads its first factor parameter.
safeMul reads its second factor parameter.
safeMul assigns the product to its local result c.
safeDiv reads its dividend parameter.
safeDiv reads its divisor parameter.
safeDiv assigns the quotient to its local result c.
transferOwnership writes its _newOwner parameter into state.
transfer credits the caller-supplied recipient address.
transfer moves the caller-supplied token amount.
approve grants an allowance to the caller-supplied spender.
approve stores the caller-supplied allowance amount.
transferFrom debits balances[from] for the caller-supplied from address.
transferFrom credits the caller-supplied recipient address.
transferFrom moves the caller-supplied token amount.

allowance queries the caller-supplied tokenOwner.
allowance queries the caller-supplied spender.

approveAndCall forwards the caller-supplied bytes data.
transferAnyERC20Token calls the caller-supplied token contract address.
transferAnyERC20Token forwards the caller-supplied token amount.
approveAndCall invokes an external contract, allowing it to re-enter the token before state finalization.
The untrusted spender contract can call back into approveAndCall/transferFrom during receiveApproval.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to an arbitrary ERC20 contract.
The arbitrary tokenAddress contract executes code that could re-enter the owner-only function path.
